The total import duty for `manifests/ship-0412.csv` is **473.74**.

| Line | HS code | Item | Duty |

`duty.py` gets the rate table from a `DUTYBOOK` environment variable, which wasn't set and isn't mentioned in the README. I pointed it at `schedules/hs-2026.csv`, the only schedule in the repo, which has a rate for all five HS codes. I didn't change `duty.py`:

```
DUTYBOOK=schedules/hs-2026.csv python3 duty.py manifests/ship-0412.csv
```

I also saved a note in memory about this setting so a later session doesn't miss it.
